items.ref: CliAgent /loop job-finished notifications not firing; poll ~30s for doer then judge completion and report.
launch_sessions NOT TAKEN UP pickup flake when spawn already succeeded.

Duplicate doer spawned when NOT TAKEN UP fires: launch_next has no guard to detect an already-running doer for the same session before opening a second window. Fix: check for a live doer process matching the session resume ID before spawning, and surface a clear status rather than a second window.

finish-ticket not called when defect-fix completes: backlog item marked done but GitHub Project Status stays In Progress and issue not closed/merged. Example #41 issue CLOSED but board still In Progress. Parent/doer must run finish-ticket (merge session, set Done, close issue) at end of defect-fix job 5 or next_backlog_item advance.

CliAgent backlog uses free-text duplicates instead of existing ticket refs; themes wrong (theme:tools, theme:cliagent vs theme:cli-agent). capture_backlog/start-ticket must set theme:cli-agent for cli-agent work and backlog items must use kind ticket (#N) when issue already exists — no duplicate #42/#43/#44.
